name: Paliperidone
effects: Active metabolite of risperidone — similar but not renally cleared differently
Extended-release oral tablet (OROS technology): once-daily dosing
Highest prolactin elevation among atypicals (like risperidone)
Monthly (Invega Sustenna) or quarterly (Invega Trinza) IM depot options
Low metabolic burden relative to olanzapine/quetiapine

halfLifeEvidence.quote: The terminal elimination half-life of paliperidone is approximately 23 hours.
